2.30.0.name: deepen-plan
2.30.0.description: Stress-test an existing implementation plan and selectively strengthen weak sections with targeted research. Use when a plan needs more confidence around decisions, sequencing, system-wide impact, risks, or verification. Best for Standard or Deep plans, or high-risk topics such as auth, payments, migrations, external APIs, and security. For structural or clarity improvements, prefer document-review instead.
